test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is **NOT** correct regarding the election of Vice-President?

options.text: He/she is qualified for election as a member of the House of People.
He/she is qualified for election as a member of the Council of States.
He/she has completed the age of 35 years of age.
He/she must be a citizen of India.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He/she is qualified for election as a member of the House of People**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Election of Vice-President**

 
 
• The **Vice-President is elected by an electoral college made up of representatives from both Houses of Parliament **using a single transferable vote under the proportional representation system.
 
• **Voting** in this election is conducted **confidentially**.
 
• All members of **both Houses of Parliament make up the Electoral College, which chooses the Vice-President**.
 
• A candidate cannot win the vice presidential nomination unless –
 
 
• **He/she is qualified for election as a member of the Council of States.**
 
• **He/she has completed the age of 35 years of age.**
 
• **He/she must be a citizen of India.**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Vice-President is not a **member of the state legislature or of either house of parliament**.
 
• If a **member of either the House of Parliament or the House of the Legislature of any state is elected vice president, he or she is deemed to have resigned from that position** on the day they enter the office. 
 
• When the **President cannot perform his duties because of absence, illness, or any other reason, the Vice-President serves as President until a new President is elected** and is the **ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha**.
